Uranium and fuel are dangerous in your inventory: a whole carried stack noticeably raises your dose.
Reinforced Concrete and metal stop gamma rays
Neutrons need Borated Concrete or a lot of water
Hold a Geiger Counter to see the dose rate and your accumulated dose
The suit is crafted from yellow wool, glass panes and Create iron sheets. Strong gamma and neutron exposure still needs physical shielding.
createatomic.ponder.reactor_operation.te: Enter the chamber and right-click the chosen Fuel Channel with a fresh fuel rod. That channel becomes loaded.
Fill the reactor with Water Buckets while standing inside. The water goes into the reactor coolant tank.
For automation, connect a Create pipe/pump to any exterior casing block. The controller remains free for kinetic output.
A Redstone signal on the controller sets control-rod withdrawal. Zero signal keeps the rods inserted.
Engineer's Goggles show the verified multiblock size, fuel, temperature, coolant, power and rod position.
Decay heat remains after shutdown. Severe overheating triggers SCRAM and an extreme temperature causes a major accident and explosion.
Shift + right-click a cold loaded channel with an empty hand to return its fresh rod. Spent fuel is unloaded from the cold controller.
createatomic.ponder.reactor_structure.te: Build a large vessel from Reactor Casing: the floor and all four side walls use casing.
Place the Controller in a vertical wall. Its shaft stays outside. Do not add a roof — players enter through the open top.
Enter the chamber and place Fuel Channels by hand. Then load each channel individually with a fresh fuel rod.
Control Rods are regular internal blocks too. Minimum: one control rod for every four fuel channels.
The internal size is now 9x9x9 up to 15x15x15. The chamber must be rectangular and the top is intentionally open for maintenance.
Fill water with buckets from inside. A Create pipe or pump can connect to ANY outer casing block, so the kinetic shaft no longer blocks cooling access.
For the RBMK variant, add at least as much graphite as fuel channels. For the PWR variant, leave graphite out.
createatomic.ponder.tag.atomic_energy.de: A large serviceable Create nuclear reactor, radiation, corium and shielding.
jei.createatomic.info.anti_rad_pills: Remove part of your accumulated radiation dose. Use them when you feel sick.
jei.createatomic.info.borated_concrete: Shielding that also stops neutron radiation. Build it around the reactor.
jei.createatomic.info.control_rod: Placed inside the chamber, at least 1 per 4 Fuel Channels. Controlled by the redstone signal on the Reactor Controller.
jei.createatomic.info.corium: Corium is the extremely hot molten-fuel residue of a severe reactor accident. It scorches the ground and remains highly radioactive.
jei.createatomic.info.fuel_channel: Place inside the chamber. Stand inside and right-click it with a fresh fuel rod to load that exact channel.
jei.createatomic.info.fuel_rod: Place Fuel Channels inside the reactor. Then stand inside the chamber and right-click a channel with a fresh fuel rod. One channel holds one rod.
jei.createatomic.info.geiger_counter: Hold it to see the radiation dose rate, your accumulated dose and the radiation types around you.
jei.createatomic.info.graphite: Placed inside the chamber, at least one per Fuel Channel, turns the reactor into a graphite-moderated RBMK type: more power, but unstable at low coolant.
jei.createatomic.info.hazmat: Craft the Hazmat Suit from yellow wool, glass panes and Create iron sheets. Wear all four pieces.
jei.createatomic.info.ingot: Smelt Crushed Uranium or unpack a Block of Uranium to get it. Press it into a Uranium Plate with Create's Mechanical Press. Used for the Reactor Controller and fuel rods. Radioactive.
jei.createatomic.info.irradiated_leaves: Replaces normal leaves in the contaminated zone with a dedicated orange-yellow radioactive texture.
jei.createatomic.info.irradiated_soil: A real terrain replacement used in the fallout zone: its own orange-brown texture and persistent low radiation.
jei.createatomic.info.ore: Uranium Ore generates underground. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better and crush it in Create's Crushing Wheels for more output. It is radioactive: do not carry stacks of it around.
jei.createatomic.info.raw: Raw Uranium drops from the ore. Crush it, then smelt or blast the crushed ore into Uranium Ingots. Radioactive.
jei.createatomic.info.reactor_casing: The casing forms the floor and four side walls of the large vessel. Leave the top open. A Create pipe/pump can connect to any outer wall block.
jei.createatomic.info.reactor_core: Place the controller in a vertical wall. Its shaft stays outside for Create kinetic power; fuel and water are loaded from inside.
jei.createatomic.info.reinforced_concret: Dense shielding that stops gamma radiation. Build it around the reactor.
jei.createatomic.info.spent_fuel_rod: Burnt fuel is far more radioactive than fresh fuel. Unload it from a cold reactor (sneak + right-click with an empty hand) and handle it with a Hazmat Suit.
message.createatomic.busy: Fuel is already operating. Wait for the batch to finish and the reactor to cool.
message.createatomic.channel_loaded: This fuel channel is already loaded.

message.createatomic.err_large: The internal chamber must be no larger than 15x15x15

message.createatomic.err_roof: A service opening must remain above the chamber; the reactor top is intentionally open
message.createatomic.err_shape: the chamber must be a plain rectangular box
message.createatomic.err_small: The internal chamber must be at least 9x9x9
message.createatomic.err_wall: wall must be Reactor Casing; found a block at %d %d %d
message.createatomic.inside_only: You must stand inside the reactor chamber to manually load fuel and fill water.
message.createatomic.pills_not_needed: You feel fine, no need for pills.
